summary: PR-122 is not closeout-ready. Three code/harness defects, three scope/provenance defects, and one merge-integrity defect require correction. Two red consumer findings are expected reseal staleness rather than independent code defects, but remain blocking until regenerated and checked. The no-scientific-promotion boundary itself remains intact.

claim_results.basis: F-PR122-CODE-001 is a schema fail-open; F-PR122-CODE-002 and F-PR122-CODE-003 otherwise support the fixed-point and build-local cache designs.
HARN-001 and HARN-002 are substantive fail-closed defects; HARN-003 is blocking reseal staleness; the merged review artifact also dropped three finding IDs.
No scientific promotion occurred, but PR122-PHYSSTAT-001, -003, and -004 prevent exact, provenance-clean closeout.
Current execution remains zero-command, but PR122-PHYSSTAT-002 identifies an active roadmap instruction that contradicts the frozen complete skip.

merge_integrity_finding.statement: All five raw HARN findings omit evidence_fingerprint. MERGED_RESULTS consequently collapses HARN-001/HARN-002/HARN-003 into HARN-001 with duplicate_count=3 and HARN-004/HARN-005 into HARN-004 with duplicate_count=2. The raw inputs contain 13 distinct finding_ids, while the merge reports 10 and drops HARN-002, HARN-003, and HARN-005.
merge_integrity_finding.required_resolution: Require a non-empty evidence_fingerprint for every substantive finding and fail merge validation when it is absent; add fingerprints to all HARN findings, regenerate MERGED_RESULTS, and verify all 13 raw finding_ids survive exactly once.
